content:
Mostly as learning project, I have implemented the computation of Smith form for matrices over euclidean domains.

It required me to actually write new implementations of matrices and polynomials, based on arrays. I tried to take efficiency into consideration when designing the data types (Mathlib's function-based matrices complexity explodes when you accumulate operations over a particular matrix), but the underlying Smith form algorithm is just a basic schoolbook one.

The theorems that prove the correctness are also in the project, together with three particular executable implementations : integers, rational polynomials, and polynomials over a prime field.

The code is here: https://github.com/miguelmarco/SmithForm/tree/master/Smith
